uiChanges: Added compact horizontal day-jump pill strip (.day-strip) on Day Detail for 1-tap switching across all days on iPhone viewports.
Added multi-area halal and prayer quick-jump bar (.day-area-bar) on Day Detail and multi-area Food views, with per-area prayer links and counts matching their exact destination.

Added progressive disclosure on Day Detail for route strategy, practical logistics, rain/low-energy alternatives, vetted private/women-only spa options (using neutral plain privacy chips), and excess watch-outs beyond 4.

Enhanced Zone cards with optional option/priority badges, highlight callouts, collapsible zone tips, item-name summary previews, and auto-opening the primary category when a zone has zero sight stops.

Enhanced Place rows and Place Detail sheet/inspector with structured field notes, prayer room access badges, last-entry/tax-free metadata, and primary-source check dates strictly limited to directly read official pages.
